recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. The authoritative Coverage model already matches the Jira decision; this source fix removes the remaining misleading transition-era wording from a built Coverage example without altering conformance semantics.

additional_context: Coverage is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition defines Coverage.class with type, value, and name children, and examples use class entries for group, plan, subclass, sequence, and pharmacy card data. No Coverage.grouping or Coverage.sequence definitions remained, but the primary Coverage example retained a stale XML comment saying class was proposed to replace grouping. FHIR-15563 shared the historical implementation commit but concerns copay detail, so it was not decided here. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting context.
